SELECT messages.*, api_keys.name AS agent_name, sessions.label AS session_label,
            sessions.branch AS session_branch, sessions.status AS session_status
     FROM messages
     LEFT JOIN api_keys ON api_keys.id = messages.agent_id
     LEFT JOIN sessions ON sessions.id = messages.session_id
     WHERE messages.agent_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
       AND (messages.direction = 'agent_to_boss'
  AND (CASE WHEN json_valid(messages.metadata)
       THEN json_array_length(messages.metadata, '$.options') > 0
       ELSE 0 END
       OR messages.mode = 'blocking'))
       AND (messages.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read')
  AND (messages.expires_at IS NULL OR messages.expires_at > ?)
  AND (CASE WHEN json_valid(messages.metadata)
       THEN json_extract(messages.metadata, '$.options_expired') IS NOT 1
       ELSE 1 END))
       AND NOT (messages.expires_at IS NULL AND julianday(messages.created_at) < julianday('now') - 1)
       
     ORDER BY messages.created_at DESC, messages.id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT messages.*, api_keys.name AS agent_name
     FROM messages
     LEFT JOIN api_keys ON api_keys.id = messages.agent_id
     WHERE (messages.agent_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) OR messages.target_agent_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?))
       AND messages.updated_at >= ?
     ORDER BY messages.updated_at ASC, messages.id ASC
SELECT s.* FROM sessions s WHERE s.agent_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)  ORDER BY s.last_seen_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM messages WHERE agent_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.role, a.avatar_url, a.last_used_at, a.created_at,
      (SELECT json_group_array(slug) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.slug FROM sessions s
        JOIN projects p ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE s.agent_id = a.id ORDER BY p.slug)) AS project_slugs
      FROM api_keys a WHERE a.id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT p.panel_id, p.agent_id, k.name AS agent_name, p.target_boss_id, p.task_key, p.session_id, s.label AS session_label, p.title, p.catalog_id, p.catalog_version, p.definition_revision, p.metadata_version, p.summary_json, p.request_hash, p.created_at, p.lifecycle_json, p.final_snapshot_json, p.supersedes_panel_id FROM panels p JOIN api_keys k ON k.id = p.agent_id LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.id = p.session_id WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.panel_id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT p.panel_id, p.agent_id, k.name AS agent_name, p.target_boss_id, p.task_key, p.session_id, s.label AS session_label, p.title, p.catalog_id, p.catalog_version, p.definition_revision, p.metadata_version, p.summary_json, p.request_hash, p.created_at, p.lifecycle_json, p.final_snapshot_json, p.supersedes_panel_id FROM panels p JOIN api_keys k ON k.id = p.agent_id LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.id = p.session_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND (p.created_at < ? OR (p.created_at = ? AND p.panel_id < ?)) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.panel_id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT * FROM messages WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < ?
       AND status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read')
       AND (json_extract(metadata, '$.options') IS NOT NULL OR mode = 'blocking')
       ORDER BY expires_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT messages.*, api_keys.name AS agent_name, sessions.label AS session_label, sessions.branch AS session_branch
     FROM messages
     LEFT JOIN api_keys ON api_keys.id = messages.agent_id
     LEFT JOIN sessions ON sessions.id = messages.session_id
     WHERE messages.agent_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
       AND messages.direction = 'agent_to_boss'
       AND messages.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read')
       AND json_extract(messages.metadata, '$.options') IS NOT NULL
       AND messages.expires_at > ?
     ORDER BY messages.created_at ASC

SELECT r.request_id, r.panel_id, r.revision, r.blocking, r.expires_at, r.created_at,
      json_extract(d.definition_json, '$.title') AS title
    FROM interaction_requests r JOIN panels p ON p.panel_id = r.panel_id
    JOIN interaction_revisions d ON d.request_id = r.request_id AND d.revision = r.revision
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bosses b WHERE b.id = p.target_boss_id AND b.archived_at IS NULL AND
    (b.role = 'admin' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM boss_agent_access ba
      WHERE ba.boss_id = b.id AND ba.agent_id = p.agent_id))) AND p.target_boss_id = ? AND r.state = 'open' AND (r.expires_at IS NULL OR r.expires_at > ?)
      AND json_extract(p.lifecycle_json, '$.taskState') IN ('running', 'paused') 
    ORDER BY r.created_at, r.request_id LIMIT ?
